title: Inducing Political Bias Allows Language Models Anticipate Partisan Reactions to Controversies

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting an instruction-tuned LLM to generate responses from liberal and conservative perspectives on controversial topics (e.g., COVID-19, abortion, congressional issues), and evaluating the alignment of the generated text's stances, emotions, and moral foundations with real-world partisan tweets using Kullback-Leibler Divergence (KLD) and partisan class tendency prediction accuracy.
